newsitem.title: USA: Hershey Foods sees challenging 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Hershey Foods sees challenging 2nd half.

text.p: Hershey Foods Corp said Friday it expects the second half of 1997 to be a challenge because of the dilutive effect its acquisition of Leaf North America is having on earnings and because of the absence of profit contributions from European businesses it has sold.
Hershey chairman and chief executive officer Kenneth Wolfe also said it will be difficult to measure up against the strong second half posted in 1996.
"In the aggregate, however, 1997 will be another excellent year for Hershey Foods," Wolfe said. He sees the company reporting record sales and profits again at year end.

Hershey bought Leaf North America from Huhtamaki Oy in December 1996 in a deal valued at about $330 million. Shortly afterward, Wolfe said he expected the acquisition to be slightly dilutive to earnings.
The company sold its European operations in late 1996.
